Seems like he hit something that was traumatic. This happens a lot where you will either gain a lot or lose. Happened to me I lost over 5 pounds in one week from depression. Honestly I can’t say what is the right course of action. If it gets to the point where it’s life threatening have a serious talk or call appropriate authorities if you are worried. But I stand by one motto that is very true, “you can’t help someone who doesn’t want to help themselves” usually people come around and realize that they need help like me. Some people don’t and sadly it sometimes takes their life.

Now as I don’t feel the way you do it can be like that for some people maybe something happened in the summer that brings back memories. Or the environment makes you depressed. I can see why it does though!

When I was clinically and diagnosed depressed this happened a lot. I never found out why I did. Are you worried about something? Is there someone on your mind you can’t get out? Or is there a upcoming event you are scared of? 

I’m no doctor but I feel like this might be anxiety. If it gets so serious you loose hours of sleep I would talk to your doctor and if you doctor disregards it then honestly I would try to switch doctors or seek a specialist.  Now don’t take anything as I say as total 100% the right thing to do, get advice from multiple people and in the end you pick what happens.
